text.p: There is strong international interest in the privatisation of the Estonian state telecom company ahead of its privatisation in 1998, Aripaev business paper said on Monday.
The state telecom company has attracted interest from Normura and Banque Paribas, according to the telecom's chief executive Toomas Somera, the business daily said.
Peeter Saks, manager of local investment house Talinvest, said his firm intends to submit a bid for the telecom company, the paper said.
Saks did not rule out a joint bid with Banque Paribas, as the company did for the privatisation of Lithuanian telecom.
The state telecom company's draft privatisation plan will see one third of the Telecom's shares floated in 1998 on the Tallinn stock exchange and a foreign bourse.
The final privatisation plan is expected to be completed this year.
